title: Local devices
description: Connect a local companion to use repositories and resources approved on your computer.
actionFailed: The operation failed. Refresh the device and try again.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
enrollmentTitle: Complete the connection on your computer
tokenHint: Run the command on your computer and paste this token into its standard input when requested. The token is shown only here, expires at {{expires}}, and is not a device credential.
confirmHint: After local approval, refresh this list, review the device and its permissions, then confirm here. Start the companion only after confirmation.
expired: This pairing has expired. Start a new connection.
confirmDescription: Allow {{label}} to serve the repositories and limits shown below for your account.
revokeDescription: Disconnect {{label}} and refuse further requests using its current device credential. The device's local data is not deleted.
limits: {{cpu}} CPU · {{memory}} GiB memory · {{storage}} GiB storage · up to {{count}} sandboxes
resourcesDescription: Create and manage GitHub Codespaces or approved local sandboxes through the same resource controls.
createHint: You hold {{held}} of {{max}} resources under this provider's Moira limits. Local capacity and its approval lease are controlled on the device.
connectionRequired: Connect and confirm a local device with approved repositories above.
unavailable: Local work is unavailable. Check the device's enabled state, approval lease and connection, then refresh.
localDisclosure: Local execution uses only the repositories, limits and lease approved on the device. Revoking access here does not delete local files.
